title: Add European counted effect table extraction and runtime binding
changes: Publish the 3,016-byte E618 projection in e362-d361 with counted source bounds, directory checks, original guest addresses and e361 compatibility.
validation: Windows build pv6sdirf and Wine xutdfh0i pass. Original readers cover all 1,455 samples, six directory slots and fifteen literal sites with altered backing. They consume 5,972 managed bytes with matching state and clock.
Stage g3g2y23h retains the verified 164-file dataset. CLI creation, verification and reuse, e361 attachment, two invalid candidates, 2,496 mixed boundary reads, 17 input guards and Wine drain pass.
limitations: Ordinary triggers, selector domains, clipped variants, translated paths, Linux, USA and native Windows remain in recovery. No performance measurements.
